explanation: This P225H mutation does not meaningfully reduce nevirapine binding; the predicted energetic effect is essentially neutral (ΔΔG ≈ 0 kcal/mol). The histidine substitution is positioned ~43 Å away from the ligand in the palm domain—far beyond the direct binding pocket—and makes no direct contacts with nevirapine, indicating this mutation operates through indirect allosteric mechanisms rather than disrupting critical drug-binding interactions. The modest introduction of positive charge and loss of hydrophobicity at this remote catalytic core position likely has negligible impact on the conformational dynamics or electrostatic environment governing NNRTI binding affinity.
